metadata.description: The native shell conformance rows (T02, E rows a provider owns): the real sandbox provider and the machine's own Bash, positive controls before negatives, network negatives judged by canaries outside the sandbox. Writes a JSON receipt when TAU_SHELL_CONFORMANCE_RECEIPT is set. Cacheable only under the shell environment fingerprint (scripts/src/shell-evidence.ts, CF-1): the hash covers the source closure and the row's OS, kernel, Bash, runner image, sandbox runtime and node-pty, and is a fresh nonce unless the run asked for reuse, so candidate, drift and promotion runs never hit. A hit restores the receipt that first proved the verdict and its verdict record; the workflow's uncached stamp step says so.
